Beginning to trace where derived memo metadata is computed, which operations trigger recomputation, and what properties are extracted.

`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` computes the metadata via `markdown.ExtractAll`. It extracts tags, properties such as `hasLink`, `hasCode`, and `hasTaskList`, and possibly mentions. Recomputation is triggered by `CreateMemo` and `UpdateMemo` when content changes. `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` exists but is unused in production.
I'll trace how memo payload metadata is computed, what triggers a rebuild, and what fields it extracts.

The full list of properties extracted by ExtractAll must be identified. All recomputation triggers must be confirmed. RebuildMemoPayload stores Tags and Property but omits Mentions.

I will read ExtractAll and the proto Property message. I will also check for other rebuild trigger sites.

CreateMemo always rebuilds the payload. UpdateMemo rebuilds it only when the content path is in the update mask. memopayload.Runner.RunOnce exists but is not wired in production.

ExtractAll computes tags, mentions, and properties. RebuildMemoPayload stores only tags and property in the payload. Mentions are kept separately via ExtractAll in memo_mention_helpers. The preview metadata includes has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, and title. Location is user-set. The computation site is RebuildMemoPayload → ExtractAll.
Mentions are extracted by ExtractAll but omitted from the payload by RebuildMemoPayload. The stored fields represent the derived metadata.

h14.
memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload → markdown.ExtractAll; CreateMemo and UpdateMemo (content); tags plus Property (title, has_link, has_code, has_task_list, has_incomplete_tasks)

Derived list/preview metadata lives on `storepb.MemoPayload` (`proto/store/memo.proto`). It is rebuilt by `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, which calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go`). Production triggers are `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`) and `UpdateMemo` when the update mask includes `content` (`:447`). The persistable extract is `#tags` and `Property`: first H1 `title`, `has_link`, `has_code`, `has_task_list`, `has_incomplete_tasks`. `ExtractAll` also collects `@mentions`, but `RebuildMemoPayload` does not store them on the payload. `Runner.RunOnce` can rebuild all memos but is not started with the server.
